package main // Board is live: its unexported fields that aren't states are server state // the session tracks, and its methods write its states by assignment. type Board struct { ui.Live rows []Row // server state: tracked n int // server state: tracked seen map[string]bool // server state: tracked tab ui.State[string] open ui.State[bool] count ui.State[int] scratch []string `vuka:"-"` // not tracked } func (b *Board) Add(name string) { if b.seen == nil { b.seen = map[string]bool{} } b.rows = append(b.rows, Row{Name: name}) b.seen[name] = true b.n += 10 b.scratch = append(b.scratch, name) } func (b *Board) Bump() { b.n++ b.count++ } func (b *Board) Rename(i int, name string) { b.rows[i].Name = name } func (b *Board) Reset() { b.tab = "env" b.open = !b.open b.open = false }

{len(rows)} rows, n: {n}
